column1: # Recorded against RTEMS pin b03d4c0119 with patches/rtems/ applied, the
# Espressif QEMU fork at 2546b01, and the toolchain in ~/rtems/7 (GCC 15.2.0,
# Compared by name, not by count, so a new failure cannot hide behind a fixed
# one.  A name here that now passes is as much a change as a new name.
# Every FAIL below is the same thing and none of them is a defect: the part has
# 320 KiB of RAM (RamBase 0x3fc80000, RamEnd 0x3fcd0000), of which 307 KiB is
# work area, and these tests want a 512 KiB RAM disk -- 1.67x the whole work
# area.  The fstests share ramdisk_support.h (RAMDISK_BLOCK_SIZE 512 x
# RAMDISK_BLOCK_COUNT 1024); fsdosfssync01 declares its own at the same size
# and fsdosfsformat01 asks for 1024 sparse sectors in its FAT16 case.  They are
# unrunnable on this silicon rather than broken on it, which is why they are
